visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white line engraving depicting three figures in a wooded, outdoor setting near a stream. A man dressed in fringed buckskin clothing stands in the foreground, holding the hand of a woman wearing a long, dark dress and a veil or head covering. Behind them, standing near a large rock and tree, is a man wearing feathers in his hair and traditional indigenous-style clothing with a sheathed knife at his waist. The style is characteristic of 19th-century book illustration.
